name: UM6P-J-PAL Applied Lab for Agriculture (UJALA), funded by OCP Nutricrops

self.title: UJALA Researcher-Led Evaluations RFP (Letter of Intent)

collect_note: Reads the Letter of Intent deadline from the UJALA Researcher-Led Evaluations RFP page twice a day. The fall 2026 round (LOI 30 Oct 2026) is closed, so no call shows until J-PAL posts the next round's dates on this page.

zero_reason.quote: The fall RFP is closed to new applications. Submitted applications are under review.

evidence: Channels tried 2026-11-12: plain GET of the RFP page HTTP 200 (Drupal, static HTML, 15 KB text); endpoint_recon verdict html_ok, no opportunity endpoint; /jsonapi/node/article 404; sitemap.xml has 2 URLs and no RFP section; site-wide /rss.xml is HTTP 200 but is a general research-news feed with no RFP items; /rfp, /funding-opportunities and /research-resources/rfps all 404; the UJALA initiative page only repeats the same closed notice. Page labels the program's own dates: 'Required Letter of Intent (LOI) Deadline: October 30, 2026', full proposal 18 Dec 2026 by invitation. The regex matches that labelled LOI date and a past date yields no item, so the filter was tested against the last known call.
